mapper.select: SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.TITLE, P.PRICE, P.STATUS, P.CREATED_AT, PM.THUMBNAIL_URL AS MAIN_IMAGE FROM PRODUCTS P LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_MEDIA PM ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PM.PRODUCT_ID AND PM.MEDIA_ORDER = 1 WHERE P.WRITER_NO = #{userNo} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT C.COMMENT_ID, C.PRODUCT_ID, C.CONTENT, C.CREATED_AT, P.TITLE AS PRODUCT_TITLE FROM COMMENTS C JOIN PRODUCTS P ON C.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE C.WRITER_NO = #{userNo} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT W.WISHLIST_ID, P.PRODUCT_ID, P.TITLE, P.PRICE, P.TRADE_TYPE, PM.THUMBNAIL_URL AS MAIN_IMAGE, W.CREATED_AT AS WISHED_AT FROM WISHLISTS W JOIN PRODUCTS P ON W.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_MEDIA PM ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PM.PRODUCT_ID AND PM.MEDIA_ORDER = 1 WHERE W.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY W.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT RV.VIEW_ID, P.PRODUCT_ID, P.TITLE, P.PRICE, P.STATUS, PM.THUMBNAIL_URL AS MAIN_IMAGE, RV.VIEWED_AT FROM RECENT_VIEWS RV JOIN PRODUCTS P ON RV.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_MEDIA PM ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PM.PRODUCT_ID AND PM.MEDIA_ORDER = 1 WHERE RV.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND P.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY RV.VIEWED_AT DESC
